headline: Executive order creates a new White House Office of Trade and Manufacturing Policy.
what_it_does: This order sets up an Office of Trade and Manufacturing Policy inside the White House. Based on its title, the office is meant to advise the President on trade and manufacturing issues. No summary was provided, so details about the office's specific duties are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: White House and federal trade officials
who_it_affects.how: They gain a new White House office focused on trade and manufacturing policy.
